_meta.note: Loaded as context by ingestion and assessment agents. Update this file (not the prompts) to change the category lens.

category_definition.primary: Large power transformers ≥ 100 MVA, three-phase, oil-filled, voltage classes 138 kV through 800 kV
out_of_scope: Distribution transformers < 100 MVA (handled by Eaton/Hubbell adjacent contracts)

strategic_priorities_2026.rationale: Industry lead times have grown from ~50 weeks pre-2020 to 100+ weeks. Hyperscaler datacenter and IRA grid demand is straining capacity.
strategic_priorities_2026.target_metric: Average new-order lead time ≤ 90 weeks by Q4 2026

strategic_priorities_2026.rationale: Korean and Japanese tier-1 OEMs hold ~60% of large-power market share, exposing us to APAC weather, port, and geopolitical risk.
strategic_priorities_2026.target_metric: No single country-of-origin > 45% of annual contracted volume

strategic_priorities_2026.rationale: Grain-oriented electrical steel is the critical bottleneck. Only ~6 mills globally; US domestic supply (Cleveland-Cliffs) is limited.
strategic_priorities_2026.target_metric: ≥ 2 named GOES sub-tier suppliers per tier-1 contract

strategic_priorities_2026.rationale: Fixed-price contracts without indexation transfer all commodity risk to seller, who responds with risk premium. Indexation lowers headline price.
strategic_priorities_2026.target_metric: ≥ 80% of new-contract value under indexation clauses with documented index references

strategic_priorities_2026.rationale: Given 100+ week backlog, slot reservation is itself a contractual asset. Failure to reserve is loss of optionality.
strategic_priorities_2026.target_metric: ≥ 90% of forecasted demand covered by reserved slots 18 months forward

key_indices_watched.GOES: CRU Group Grain-Oriented Electrical Steel Index
